fato_historico: 1913: Queen Wilhelmina opens the Peace Palace in The Hague.
energia_do_dia: The universe invites you to build bridges of understanding, much like the grand halls of peace opened to unite the world. It is a good time to consider how your unique intellectual spark can foster harmony in your social circles. You may find that your most innovative ideas are exactly what your community needs to thrive today.
frase_do_dia: Peace begins within your own brilliant and expansive mind today.
significado_numero: Represents the power of collaboration and building lasting foundations together.
conselho: Use your voice to advocate for unity and kindness in every conversation.
